entries.235a9b1ba4fd0740: As its medium-term management plan policy, it aims to build a solid management foundation through business strategies adapted to a medical environment that is changing with the progress of a declining birthrate and aging population, and through efficient organizational management. It pursues strategic investment and effective R&D in fields with expected growth, aims to realize comprehensive proposals to medical institutions and strengthen its community-based structure in home medical care, and seeks sustainable growth by providing a seamless medical environment through a one-stop service covering 'prevention, testing, treatment, follow-up, rehabilitation, home care and nursing care.' It targets consolidated revenue of ¥150 billion for the fiscal year ending March 2029.
